title: The Bright Signal
author: Felix Thackeray
blurb: Emrys Okafor, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
